item.title: Incomplete list of mistakes in the design of CSS
item.description:
📝 Table layout should be sane. word-wrap/overflow-wrap should not exist. border-radius should have been corner-radius.
🔗 Read more: https://wiki.csswg.org/ideas/mistakes

item.title: Show HN: Wirebrowser – A JavaScript debugger with breakpoint-driven heap search
item.description:
📝 Memory Inspect, search, and modify JavaScript memory using both live heap analysis and heap snapshots, with full support for object identity search, primitive search (via snapshots), structural matching, and runtime patching. Live Object Search — Search all live JavaScript objects using regex or structural matching, and patch matched objects at runtime to alter state or behavior dynamically. Memory — Live Object Search Search and patch live JS objects using regex or structural matching.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/fcavallarin/wirebrowser
